what: Plan assumes empty slot manifests are already rejected, but current dispatcher accepts them
scenario_or_breakage: An upstream manifest bug can produce ALL_OUTPUT_FILES= and DISPATCH_OK=true; with the new sidecar it would also publish an empty paths file and only fail later for callers that use --paths-file
suggested_fix: Add an explicit slot_count > 0 check before phase setup and add an empty-manifest regression to test-dispatch-with-waterfall.sh

what: The global anti-pattern still forbids zero positional collector args while the plan intentionally switches Step 3 to --paths-file
scenario_or_breakage: The edited Step 3 collect call will pass no positional output files, leaving contradictory prompt guidance that can cause future agents or reviews to restore the obsolete guard or reject the new call
suggested_fix: Revise the invariant to forbid collecting zero entries, explicitly allowing --paths-file when readable and non-empty

what: Plan leaves eval "$_plan_voter_dispatch" in place while adding another unquoted KV
scenario_or_breakage: A degraded-panel warning with spaces or any path containing shell metacharacters can make eval misparse or execute data; VOTER_PATHS_FILE widens that data surface
suggested_fix: Replace eval with a while-read case parser that whitelists VOTER_*_PATH, VOTER_*_STATUS, VOTER_*_TOOL, and DISPATCH_OK as data

what: Voter dispatchers add paths-file outputs but still consume waterfall results through space-delimited ALL_OUTPUT_FILES
scenario_or_breakage: The new one-path-per-line contract does not protect these internal handoffs; future paths with spaces still truncate VOTER_N_PATH assignments
suggested_fix: Have voter dispatchers consume dispatch-with-waterfall's ALL_OUTPUT_FILES_PATH or a paired path/tool manifest instead of read -r -a on space-delimited KVs

what: Test harness behavior changes are planned without updating sibling contracts
scenario_or_breakage: The plan extends multiple scripts/test-*.sh harnesses, but stale sibling docs under scripts/test-*.md will violate the repo's edit-in-sync rule and under-document the new paths-file assertions
suggested_fix: Add updates for scripts/test-dispatch-with-waterfall.md, scripts/test-dispatch-plan-voters.md, scripts/test-dispatch-code-voters.md, and scripts/test-collect-agent-results.md to the plan

what: The new paths-file sidecar trust model is not documented next to existing collector sidecar trust boundaries
scenario_or_breakage: A tampered paths-file can steer the collector toward arbitrary local output, .done, and .meta paths within the user's privileges; that may be acceptable, but it should be explicit like .meta and .done
suggested_fix: Document paths-files as session-local tamperable data, not an authentication boundary, and state the fail-closed guarantees and residual local-file steering risk
